description: Production-ready configuration subset with all 6 gates enabled for quality floor enforcement
purpose: Provide a minimal, validated config for deployment that includes all gate mechanisms without the full dev-loop complexity

disabled_for_production: Full skill invocation logging (only error/success events)

requirements_to_ac_to_design.contract: P0 user stories have ≥3 GWT ACs each
requirements_to_ac_to_design.verification_method: Count GWT ACs per P0 story in purified output
requirements_to_ac_to_design.pass_criteria: All P0 stories meet minimum requirement

design_to_implementation.contract: All contrast values measured; prefers-reduced-motion block present
design_to_implementation.verification_method: Mechanical audit of contrast calculations and CSS blocks
design_to_implementation.pass_criteria: Contrast values documented + motion block exists

implementation_to_testing_qa.contract: Every new function has a test that FAILED before implementation
implementation_to_testing_qa.verification_method: Git log inspection for test-first pattern

testing_qa_to_shipping_delivery.contract: Health score calculated from 8 categories with exact weights
testing_qa_to_shipping_delivery.verification_method: Check baseline.json structure and category scores
testing_qa_to_shipping_delivery.pass_criteria: All 8 categories present with correct weights

step_1_prerelease_checks: Run AC generation gate on PRD outputs
Verify TDD gate on code commits
Check A11y gate on UI assets
step_3_postdeploy_monitoring: Compare health scores against pre-deploy baseline
Alert if anomalies exceed thresholds (>3 console errors / >20% perf regression)
deployment_workflow.success_criteria: All 6 gates pass → Deployment successful | Any gate fails → Block proceed until resolved

error_handling.gate_failure_response: Block workflow execution, provide explicit failure message, suggest corrective action
error_handling.contract_violation_response: Reject artifact handoff, require correction before proceeding
error_handling.mechanical_audit_failure: Flag for manual review, do not auto-pass
error_handling.escalation_path: If gate blocked 3+ times → Escalate to human partner for decision

production_readiness_checklist: ✓ Error handling and escalation paths defined
✓ No proxy signals accepted (real audits on outputs)

new_feature_development.reason: Feature development doesn't need deploy monitoring or risk assessment yet

release_candidate_verification.reason: Pre-release requires full quality floor enforcement

hotfix_emergency.reason: Emergency fixes may skip some gates with human approval override
